tools.name: list_machines
tools.description: List every XState machine in the workspace, with its id, source file, line, and state count. Use this first to discover what exists.

tools.name: describe_machine
tools.description: Return one machine as JSON: states (hierarchy, initial/final/parallel flags, entry/exit actions, invoked services) and transitions (source, target, event). For large machines, pass `parent` (and optionally `depth`) to scope the result to one subtree instead of the whole machine.

file.description: Optional source path substring to disambiguate machines that share an id.

parent.description: Optional state label or id — scope the result to this state's descendants instead of the whole machine.

depth.description: Optional levels below `parent` to include (1 = direct children only). Requires `parent`. Omit for unlimited.

tools.name: machine_diagram
tools.description: Return a Mermaid `stateDiagram-v2` for one machine.

file.description: Optional source path substring to disambiguate machines that share an id.

tools.name: test_paths
tools.description: Shortest event sequence to reach each state of a machine (structural — guards assumed takeable), unreachable states flagged, plus copy-paste test skeletons.

file.description: Optional source path substring to disambiguate machines that share an id.

tools.name: find_implementation
tools.description: Resolve an action/guard/actor name to its source definition: same file, then imported modules, then a workspace-wide text search. Returns file:line and a short snippet.

machine.description: Optional machine id (from list_machines) to search from its file first.

file.description: Optional source path substring to search from, if `machine` is not given.

tools.name: validate
tools.description: Run XState diagnostics (invalid config properties, unknown transition targets, unreachable states, etc.) over the workspace or one file.

file.description: Optional source path substring. Omit to validate every XState file.

tools.name: find_references
tools.description: Find every place a name is USED across the workspace as an XState action, guard, invoked actor (service), or event — the inverse of where it is defined. Returns each usage with its machine, enclosing state, file and line.

name.description: The action/guard/actor/event name to find usages of.

file.description: Optional source path substring to restrict the search.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List the events a machine handles — its send() API. For each event, the states that handle it and any guard/target. Eventless (always) and delayed (after) transitions are flagged as automatic.

file.description: Optional source path substring to disambiguate machines that share an id.

tools.name: state_detail
tools.description: Focused detail for one state of a machine, by label or id: entry/exit actions, invoked services, and outgoing transitions (event, target, guard, actions).

file.description: Optional source path substring to disambiguate machines that share an id.

tools.name: setup_coverage
tools.description: For one XState v5 machine, which actions/guards/actors are referenced and which are MISSING an implementation in setup() (plus which declared ones are unused).

file.description: Optional source path substring to disambiguate machines that share an id.
